data.title: Schoolgirl Yu scorches to second gold as doping case rocks Asian Games
data.description: NAGOYA (JAPAN) - Schoolgirl swimmer Yu Zidi won her second gold of the Asian Games on Monday with the fastest time in the world this year, while a teenage badminton player became the first doping case.

data.title: Doping shock rocks Thailand camp at Asian Games
data.description: Badminton player Pitchamon Opatniputh has emerged as the first known doping case at the 20th Asian Games in Japan, after the 19-year-old rising star returned a positive test that has rocked Thailand's campaign in Aichi-Nagoya.

data.title: Flights scrapped,1.6 million people urged to evacuate as Typhoon Dujuan nears Tokyo
data.description: TOKYO – Hundreds of flights were cancelled, and more than one million people were under evacuation advisories in Japan on Monday as Typhoon Dujuan approached Tokyo, potentially bringing record rainfall.

data.title: Putin's party secures record score in Russia election
data.description: MOSCOW - Vladimir Putin's United Russia party won a record supermajority in the Duma, authorities announced Monday after a tightly controlled three-day election without parties critical of the Kremlin or the war in Ukraine.

data.title: Officials say man shot, wounded by ICE agent in Texas
data.description: AUSTIN — A Venezuelan national was shot and wounded by an immigration agent in the United States, Texas officials said on Sunday as they voiced outrage and demanded a thorough investigation.

data.title: Sisters of jailed Pakistan ex-PM Imran Khan arrested
data.description: ISLAMABAD — Former Pakistan prime minister Imran Khan's party said on Monday that his three sisters had been arrested.

data.title: China confirms Xi to visit US this week for Trump talks
data.description: BEIJING — China's leader Xi Jinping will visit the United States this week for talks with President Donald Trump, Beijing confirmed Monday, expressing hope they will strengthen "strategic stability" between the world's two largest economies.

data.title: ONE Championship: Jonathan Haggerty welcomes Rodtang trilogy and Superlek rematch – ‘I’m ready for it all’
data.description: Jonathan Haggerty has opened the door to a trilogy fight with Rodtang Jitmuangnon and another meeting with Superlek Kiatmoo9 – the two rivals responsible for his only defeats in ONE Championship.

data.title: City Hall working on new master drainage plan for Bangkok
data.description: Bangkok's City Hall has partnered with a Japanese government agency in designing a long-term urban drainage master plan to prepare the capital for heavier rainfall, with a target of coping with 100 millimetres of rain per hour.

data.title: Free MRT rides for cyclists, e-scooter users on World Car Free Day, Tuesday
data.description: Passengers bringing bicycles or foldable electric scooters onto the MRT rail network on Tuesday will travel for free, because it's World Car Free Day 2026.

data.title: Woman buys gold ring on popular app, receives fake instead
data.description: NAKHON RATCHASIMA - A woman who was conned into buying a fake gold ring through a popular e-commerce platform recounted her experience on Monday as a warning to other online shoppers.

data.title: New taste tinglers for your palate
data.description: Bangkok is a city that never sleeps, at least in the food and beverage department. Blink and you’ll miss another new restaurant opening, a drink launch, or a new nightclub. Guru By Bangkok Post is making sure that even if you blink, you don’t miss out on the new taste tinglers that are worth mentioning in Bangkok and beyond.

data.title: Wonder AI accelerates smart retail expansion as AI reshapes business landscape
data.description: Wonder AI Co Ltd is speeding up its market expansion as brick-and-mortar operators increasingly turn to artificial intelligence (AI) to boost operational efficiency and capture deeper shopper insights amid shifting consumer habits and mounting overheads.

data.title: Indonesia doing 'everything' but still struggling to curb fires
data.description: PONTIANAK, Indonesia - Indonesia is doing "everything" to fight huge forest fires but dozens of planes and thousands of personnel are still struggling to contain them, a senior official said on Monday.

data.title: Japan braces for heavy rain, strong winds as typhoon nears eastern coast
data.description: A large typhoon was moving towards eastern Japan's Pacific coast Monday, with the weather agency issuing a top-level warning for landslides in the northern part of the Izu island chain.

data.title: Report claims US has deported 25,000 to third countries under secretive deals
data.description: NAIROBI - The United States has deported more than 25,000 people under secretive agreements with 35 countries to take migrants with no ties to those nations, according to an investigation report published on Monday.

data.title: China's Yu, 13, great for swimming says multiple Olympic medallist
data.description: TOKYO - China's 13-year-old sensation Yu Zidi is "exciting for the swimming world" and part of the sport's trend towards younger athletes, Hong Kong's multiple Olympic medallist Siobhan Haughey said on Monday.

data.title: Ministry demands apology over Cambodian claim to Thai historical photograph
data.description: The Thai Ministry of Culture has sent a letter demanding an apology from Miss Universe Cambodia over its misuse of a historical Thai photograph, believing it was done intentionally to cause misunderstanding about the picture's origin.

data.title: Vacheron Constantin and The Met to unveil three artisan artworks in New York
data.description: Vacheron Constantin (@vacheronconstantin) and The MET in New York, is set to unveil three artworks from the Artisan Residency Program on October 8, 2026. A mentorship programme and creativity through an exchange of knowledge and expertise between artisans at Vacheron Constantin’s watchmaking manufacture in Switzerland and The MET in New York over an 18-month period. The three artworks were created by the selected artisans participating in the program.

data.title: Landmark global study reveals critical inequities in access to dermatological care
data.description: First comprehensive global assessment by the International League of Dermatological Societies (ILDS) and L’Oréal Dermatological Beauty spans 158 countries and 97% of the world’s population
